verdict.rationale: The only support for replicas is a community report of a '2-region fully replicated ClickHouse system of 40 nodes' and general praise for 'robust cluster support'. The first-party Keeper page names a coordination service but does not describe replica addition or failover semantics, so it supports the story only indirectly. Missing for 10: first-party docs on adding read replicas, documented high-availability and failover behavior, and failover-specific hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can add read replicas and rely on documented high-availability and failover behavior
